notes: Emotional state that shapes behaviour, memory you can interrogate directly, her own persistent preferences, and a real sense of when things happened.

changelog.headline: What's new in 1.0.12

sections.title: She has a state now
items: An emotional state is computed before language rather than painted on afterwards, so it shapes what she says and whether she says it.
A wound isn't undone by an apology, trust builds slower than it breaks, and a bad mood is never an excuse to stop doing the work.

sections.title: She thinks twice
items: Sometimes a second thought lands after she has already answered, the way people actually talk.

sections.title: Memory you can actually ask
items: "What are my skills?" returns the whole list instead of the few that happened to share words with your question.
She can thread everything you have told her about one person in the order you said it, and tell you how long it has been.

sections.title: She keeps her own taste
items: Her preferences persist instead of being improvised fresh each time — and only ones she has genuinely stated, never invented to fill a gap.

sections.title: She knows when
items: Times are attached to what you said and when she was told things, so "you mentioned this back in July" comes from a real record.

sections.title: Voice and size
items: Speech generation moves to the graphics card when there is room, fixing the stutter on longer replies.
The download is smaller than last version despite everything above.

changelog.data_safety: Your chats, memory, notes, portfolio and settings stay exactly as they are. This update only replaces the app's own program files. Nothing you have created is touched or deleted.
